## extended_method (3 queries)

Broader method families and agent paradigms not fully captured by the focused core_method queries.

| id | query | gap addressed |
|----|-------|---------------|
| em-01 | "automatic literature survey generation agent" | Casts widest net on the core method category; unlike cm-01's specific LLM framing, this captures non-LLM and hybrid approaches |
| em-02 | "deep research agent paper retrieval summarization" | Captures the broader "deep research" paradigm (OpenAI Deep Research, Gemini Deep Research, Perplexity Deep Research) that competes with dedicated survey agents but is not explicitly retrieved by any main query |
| em-03 | "multi-agent collaboration scientific literature synthesis" | Broader than mc-05's "agentic loop design"; captures general multi-agent patterns for scientific knowledge work that may inspire survey-agent architectures |

## extended_mechanism (4 queries)

Alternative mechanisms, traversal strategies, and methodology families.

| id | query | gap addressed |
|----|-------|---------------|
| emc-01 | "citation graph traversal paper discovery retrieval" | Broader than mc-02/mc-04 which focus on BFS; also captures depth-first, random-walk, and hybrid traversal strategies for citation networks |
| emc-02 | "knowledge graph survey literature review generation" | Fills the ORKG / knowledge-graph dimension gap; only FAIR Literature Surveys with Scholarly KGs (2006.01747) exists in the pool; broader KG-driven approaches may exist |
| emc-03 | "snowballing citation expansion backward forward search" | Captures the pre-2020 snowballing / cocitation methodology lineage (Webster & Watson 2002, Wohlin 2014) that is entirely missing from the current pool |
| emc-04 | "iterative query decomposition refinement academic search" | Broader than cm-03's "multi-turn retrieval"; captures general query decomposition strategies (RefChain, Plan-and-Solve) that support survey agent retrieval |

## extended_problem (2 queries)

Broader failure mode coverage and quality concerns.

| id | query | gap addressed |
|----|-------|---------------|
| epr-01 | "citation hallucination attribution LLM generation" | Broader than pr-01's "survey agents" framing; captures the whole citation hallucination / attribution landscape that survey agents must inherit from the underlying LLM |
| epr-02 | "factual consistency evidence grounding scientific text" | Broader than pr-02/pr-03; covers factual consistency methods that could transfer to survey generation evaluation (complements the metric papers already in pool) |

## extended_benchmark (2 queries)

Broader evaluation landscapes.

| id | query | gap addressed |
|----|-------|---------------|
| ebm-01 | "survey generation evaluation benchmark metric coverage" | Broader than bm-01/bm-02's named benchmarks; captures evaluation frameworks that don't use the AutoSurvey/SurveyBench brand names |
| ebm-02 | "citation accuracy factual precision evaluation benchmark" | Broader than bm-04's combined metrics query; specifically targets evaluation of citation quality as a standalone concern (complements CiteEval, CiteAudit already in pool) |

## extended_boundary (3 queries)

Adjacent areas worth probing for spillover relevance.

| id | query | gap addressed |
|----|-------|---------------|
| eby-01 | "reinforcement learning paper retrieval citation traversal" | Probes the RL-for-citation-traversal gap identified in 03_expansion.md; may surface papers from the recommender systems community that use RL for paper pathfinding |
| eby-02 | "scientific claim verification fact checking attribution retrieval" | Adjacent area where attribution and evidence-gathering methods are mature; techniques (verification chains, evidence retrieval) may transfer to survey citation grounding |
| eby-03 | "human-in-the-loop systematic review screening LLM assisted" | Probes the boundary between fully automated survey agents and human-assisted SLR screening tools; may capture semi-automated systems with transferable components |
